messages:
From: Sara Ng <sara.ng@heliostx.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@heliostx.com; ops@heliostx.com
Date: 2026-06-22T14:10:00Z
Subject: Request: Project Orion prompt-output & log removal - certification and notice

Jonas,

Per our data-retention policy and the customer request for Project Orion, Helios needs Redwood to expunge all prompt inputs, model outputs, and derived prompt logs associated with the Project Orion workspace (workspace id: orion-prod-7b). Scope: user-submitted prompts between 2025-11-01 and 2026-06-15, all related KV cache entries, streaming traces, and ephemeral artifacts stored in S3/bucket: helios-orion-output-prod.

We need: 
- Confirmation of exact objects/paths you will remove and the deletion method (s3 delete vs. secure shredding).
- Ops runbook / ticket id for the purge.
- A signed deletion certificate after completion (DocuSign acceptable).
- Estimated completion date; target is EOD 2026-06-25 if possible.

Attached: Helios removal request form (filled). Please also advise if Redwood requires any additional PoC or authorization from Helios legal.

Thanks,
Sara Ng
Head of Data Privacy
Helios Therapeutics

Attachment: helios_removal_request_20260622.pdf

From: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Sara Ng <sara.ng@heliostx.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-22T17:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: Project Orion prompt-output & log removal - certification and notice

Sara — thanks for the clear scope. We can meet your target date. High-level plan and asks below. I've attached a short mutual action plan template to accelerate signoff.

Planned workflow (summary):
1) Legal/Prod acceptance: Helios confirms authorization (DocuSign ok) and designates a point-of-contact for sign-off on the deletion certificate.
2) Ops ticket & dry-run: Redwood will create an internal ops ticket (INF-4521), run a dry-list (list of objects/keys to be deleted) and share the list with Helios for a 24-hour confirmation window. This will be a non-destructive preview.
3) Purge window: Once Helios confirms the dry-list, Redwood will schedule the purge during a maintenance window (no model-serving disruption). Targets: delete S3 objects, clear related KV cache entries, and evict any cached streaming traces.
4) Verification & certificate: Ops will produce a deletion manifest and supporting logs; we will generate a deletion certificate and send via DocuSign.

Ops checklist and deliverables: dry-list (CSV), purge job id, ops runbook excerpt, deletion manifest, signed certificate. Estimated timeline: dry-list by 2026-06-23 09:00Z; purge on 2026-06-24 AM PST; verification + DocuSign by 2026-06-25 EOD.

Pre-req from Helios: DocuSign authorization for the operation and a primary contact for the 24-hour dry-list review.

I've attached a MAP for Project Orion to this thread (MAP_ProjectOrion_v1.docx). Marissa — can you create the INF ticket and a dry-list export? Grace — please confirm the exact purge commands we will run for the KV cache and whether we need any additional KMS actions for encrypted artifacts.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0162

Attachment: MAP_ProjectOrion_v1.docx

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Request: Project Orion prompt-output & log removal - certification and notice

Thanks, Jonas / Sara. INF ticket created: INF-4521 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4521). Summary of ops plan below and attached checklist.

Ops runbook excerpt (abbreviated):
- Step 1: Dry-list generation (script: tools/list_orion_objects.sh) -> output CSV attached to ticket. Non-destructive; no deletes.
- Step 2: Helios confirmation window (24 hours) -> await confirmation email or HubSpot approval.
- Step 3: Purge execution (script: tools/purge_orion_objects.sh) -> will run in two phases: S3 object delete (soft-delete retention disabled) then KV cache eviction. For encrypted objects using customer-managed KMS keys, we will zero-out the key material per KMS workflow if requested.
- Step 4: Post-purge verification: checksum mismatch check, sample retrieval attempts (should 404), and generation of deletion manifest (signed by Redwood infra lead).
- Step 5: Certificate generation & DocuSign.

Expected timestamps: dry-list posted 2026-06-23T09:00Z, purge start window 2026-06-24T15:00Z PST, verification complete 2026-06-25T12:30Z PST. I attached the ops checklist (ops_purge_checklist_20260623.xlsx).

Notes/risks: if Helios requires physical/forensic shredding of underlying storage, that triggers Private deployment escalation and will take longer.

Marissa Cole
Senior Engineering Manager, Customer Operations
Redwood Inference
Marissa will run the purge and provide the dry-list in the ticket.

Attachment: ops_purge_checklist_20260623.xlsx
